story.title: Displacement Crisis as Houthis Advance in Yemen
story.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been displaced in Yemen due to the advance of Iran-backed Houthi rebels. Reports indicate that approximately 1,400 individuals have fled across the Gulf of Aden to Djibouti, escaping what has been described as a 'hysterical panic' among those affected by the conflict.

timeline_highlights.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited a significant fire at a Wildberries warehouse near Saint Petersburg on July 24. The blaze produced thick smoke that spread across the city and led to temporary disruptions at Pulkovo Airport, as reported by Russian authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Houthis Capture Strategic Port City in Yemen, Threatening Global Shipping
timeline_highlights.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have seized control of the port city of Mokha, located approximately 80 kilometers from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. This strategic waterway is crucial for global shipping, with about 12% of the world's oil and goods passing through it. The Houthis' advance poses a significant threat to international energy supplies and shipping routes.

event_overview.title: About Russia-Ukraine War
event_overview.subject: Russia-Ukraine War
event_overview.summary: The Russia-Ukraine War is an armed conflict centered on Ukraine that grew from Russia's 2014 occupation of Crimea and fighting in eastern Ukraine into a full-scale Russian armed attack on 24 February 2022. It involves sustained ground combat and long-range strikes, including missiles and drones, and has caused extensive civilian harm, displacement and damage to civilian infrastructure.

facts.label: Origins
facts.value: The conflict’s modern phase began in 2014, when Russia occupied Crimea and hostilities began in Ukraine’s Donetsk and Luhansk regions; the United Nations General Assembly affirmed Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity within its internationally recognized borders and said the 16 March 2014 Crimea referendum could not alter Crimea’s status.

facts.label: Full-scale invasion
facts.value: The United Nations Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine states that Russian armed forces launched a full-scale armed attack on Ukraine on 24 February 2022.

facts.label: Geographic scope
facts.value: Hostilities affect Ukraine, including occupied territory and areas under Ukrainian government control; the war’s effects also extend beyond the front through long-range weapons and cross-border drone and missile incidents.

facts.label: International legal position
facts.value: On 2 March 2022, the UN General Assembly adopted resolution A/RES/ES-11/1, deploring Russia’s aggression against Ukraine and demanding that Russia immediately, completely and unconditionally withdraw its military forces from Ukraine’s internationally recognized borders. On 16 March 2022, the International Court of Justice indicated provisional measures directing Russia to suspend the military operations it had commen

facts.label: Humanitarian impact
facts.value: UNHCR’s 2026 planning appeal says the war has continued to produce acute humanitarian and protection needs in Ukraine and among refugees in Europe; it recorded 5.86 million refugees from Ukraine globally and 3.7 million internally displaced people as of December 2025.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows a limited set of late-July to mid-August 2026 developments, particularly reported strikes, casualties and diplomatic-security consequences; it does not provide a complete chronology of the war, battlefield control, peace efforts or all humanitarian impacts.

related_stories.title: Iran Reports Casualty in US Attack on Commercial Ship in Hormuz
related_stories.summary: Iranian authorities have reported that one crew member was killed when an Iranian commercial ship was struck near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. The Qeshm governor attributed the attack to a 'terrorist enemy,' though the exact nature of the projectile remains unidentified. This incident marks a continuation of tensions between the US and Iran in the region.

related_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV marked the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks with a call for peace during his Sunday blessing. Speaking in English, he emphasized the need for a renewed commitment to peace, reflecting on the impact of the attacks on his home country.

related_stories.title: Houthis Claim Attack on Saudi Base Amid Ongoing Yemen Conflict
related_stories.summary: Yemeni Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for an attack on a military base in southern Saudi Arabia, coinciding with renewed fighting against Yemen's government forces. The recent clashes have resulted in hundreds of deaths and the displacement of tens of thousands of civilians. Government forces, supported by Saudi airstrikes, are attempting to counter the Houthi advance as the conflict escalates.
